event: Thu 26 Nov: Thanksgiving, US stock and bond markets shut, thin trade. Fri 27 Nov: US half-day. Mon 30 Nov: COMEX December first notice day (UNVERIFIED). Fri 4 Dec: US jobs report (15:30 SAST, UNVERIFIED). Fed decision Wed 9 Dec, 21:00 SAST.

bullets.title: Holding near 3,580
bullets.text: Spot gold was near 3,580 at 08:01 SAST today, up about 0.1%, after bouncing from below 3,500 on Wednesday (FXEmpire).

bullets.title: Trendline test
bullets.text: Price is testing the falling trendline from 17 November around 3,600, and one chart note put it near 3,605 (time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Hikes still expected
bullets.text: Hot data (Q3 GDP 4.3%, core PCE 3.3%) keeps markets expecting a Fed hike on 9 December and another in early 2027 (FXEmpire citing Reuters).

bullets.title: Tariff headlines
bullets.text: New US tariff action against 14 trading partners on Wednesday adds some safe-haven support (FXEmpire).

bullets.title: Central banks buying
bullets.text: Central banks bought a net 321 tonnes in Q3, well above the five-year average, which supports dips over time (World Gold Council via FXEmpire).

bullets.title: Still deep down
bullets.text: Gold is down about 12% in a month and near its lowest level in over a year, so the bigger trend is still down.

bullets.title: Thin holiday trade
bullets.text: With US markets shut today, moves can be jumpy and levels can break and snap back easily.
